title: Switching between Activities very slow (background takes a second to refresh)
line: Switching activities no longer shows a black desktop: the old one stays until the new wallpaper is ready, and the new one slides in over it.
explanation: Two things made the desktop go black when switching activities. libplasma's ContainmentView hides the old desktop as soon as the containment changes, so Desktop.qml's switch animation slid the new desktop in over an empty window. And the first time an activity is shown after plasmashell starts, its desktop and wallpaper are only created then: with a large image the wallpaper takes a while to load, and the old desktop was hidden at the end of the slide anyway, so the screen stayed black until the image appeared (1.3 s for an 8K image on the test rig). The change shows the old desktop again during the slide and keeps it, in place, under the new one until the new wallpaper reports it has loaded. Repeat switches, whose wallpaper is already loaded, slide exactly as before.

commits.message:
desktoppackage: keep the old desktop until the new wallpaper has loaded

The old activity's desktop was hidden before the new one had slid in and
loaded its wallpaper, so switching showed black, for over a second on a
first switch to a large image. Keep it under the new one until then.

BUG: 476406

review.text: Setting internal.oldContainment.visible = true in the initial ScriptAction of switchAnim in Desktop.qml cleanly fixes the black flash during activity switching caused by ContainmentView hiding the old containment before the slide animation begins. The final ScriptAction and rapid-switch interruption path already hide oldContainment reliably, and the frame strips and recordings confirm the new wallpaper slides over the old one with no black frames.

reviews.text: Setting internal.oldContainment.visible = true in the initial ScriptAction of switchAnim in Desktop.qml cleanly fixes the black flash during activity switching caused by ContainmentView hiding the old containment before the slide animation begins. The final ScriptAction and rapid-switch interruption path already hide oldContainment reliably, and the frame strips and recordings confirm the new wallpaper slides over the old one with no black frames.

Both earlier requests are resolved: the first switch after a restart with 8K wallpapers was tested (master 24 and 40 black frames, rev 1 still one black frame), and the old containment is now kept under the new one until WallpaperItem.loading drops, which the image wallpaper also resets on error, so it can't get stuck. The before/after strips show the black gap is gone on first switches and the repeat slide now covers the old desktop. Cleanup on a new switch and on loading=false is handled, and rapid or mid-load switching was checked. Minor nit only: if loading ends mid-slide the old desktop's x jumps from 0 to the animated offset, which is cosmetic.

history.text: The one-liner is correct and well placed. ContainmentView hides the old item without reparenting it, and Desktop.qml's switch animation owns visibility from then on, so showing the old item again removes the black frames during the slide, as the before/after strips show. But the reporter (and the entry's own notes) describe the new background taking 1-2 s to appear. The other activity's containment item and wallpaper are created lazily (itemForApplet) on the first switch, and the image loads asynchronously. If loading outlasts the animation, the final ScriptAction still hides the old desktop over an empty new one, so black-then-wallpaper remains. That case was not tested: every recorded switch was a repeat switch with small images on a fast rig.
changes: Test the first switch to an activity after plasmashell starts, with a large image wallpaper (e.g. a 4K or 8K JPEG, or a slideshow), and record whether black appears after the slide.

If it does, keep the old containment visible until the new containment's wallpaper has finished loading, e.g. delay the final hide in switchAnim until the wallpaper reports it is loaded, so neither the slide nor the load ever shows black.

history.summary: Tested the first switch after a restart with 8K wallpapers: master showed 0.8 s and 1.3 s of black, and revision 1 still had a black frame at the end of the slide. The old desktop now stays visible, in place, under the new one until the new wallpaper reports it has loaded, so neither the slide nor the load shows black; repeat switches slide as before.

answers.request: Test the first switch to an activity after plasmashell starts, with a large image wallpaper (e.g. a 4K or 8K JPEG, or a slideshow), and record whether black appears after the slide.
answers.answer: Done on kdetest8 with two activities using 7680x4320 PNGs and plasmashell restarted before each run. On master the first switches were black for 24 and 40 frames at 30 fps. With revision 1 the old startup desktop covered the slide, but there was still a black frame when the final step hid it before the image had loaded. A first switch away from a non-startup desktop would also slide it off and show black. Media before/after-1 and -2 show the first switches, and -4 is the whole run.

answers.request: If it does, keep the old containment visible until the new containment's wallpaper has finished loading, e.g. delay the final hide in switchAnim until the wallpaper reports it is loaded, so neither the slide nor the load ever shows black.
answers.answer: Done. If containment.wallpaper.loading is still true at the end of switchAnim, the old containment is kept as leavingContainment and hidden when loading turns false, or when another switch starts. The image wallpaper only sets loading in its onCompleted, about 1 ms after the switch starts, so the slide-out can't be decided up front. The animation now drives an internal offset, and the old containment's x follows it only while the new wallpaper isn't loading. Otherwise the old desktop stays at 0 under the new one. Rapid switching and switching during a load end on the right desktop with nothing left behind.
